install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; PIP_HELP=$(pip3 install --help 2>/dev/null || true); case "$PIP_HELP" in *--break-system-packages*) PIP_EXTRA='--break-system-packages' ;; *) PIP_EXTRA='' ;; esac; pip3 install --user $PIP_EXTRA --no-input -r requirements-dev.txt && bundle config set --local path vendor/bundle && bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3 && if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm ci --prefix scripts/paper_video --no-audit --no-fund; fi
